title: Authoritative GIV-PTS VO2 Model Configuration
description: Authoritative machine-readable model configuration and governing parameters for the VO2-graphene Gate-Induced-Volatile Phase-Transition Switch (GIV-PTS).

poole_frenkel_enhancement.equation: E_reg = sqrt(E_field^2 + E0^2); PF_exponent = min(beta_E * sqrt(E_reg) / (e_q * k_B_eV * T), 5.0); sigma_ins_PF = sigma_ins * exp(PF_exponent)
poole_frenkel_enhancement.rationale: Captures pre-switching subthreshold non-ohmic field-assisted transport in the insulating state.

kinetic_field_coupling_gamma_E.rationale: Explicit drain-field barrier lowering is constrained to gamma_E = 0 to prevent unphysical field-assisted thermal artifacts without separate experimental validation.

capacitance_partition.quantum_capacitance_equation: sqrt_N2D = (-b + sqrt(b^2 - 4*a*c)) / (2*a) where a = e_q / C_top, b = hbar*v_F*sqrt(pi)/e_q, c = -v_unipolar

charge_transfer_efficiency_eta_CT.classification: Phenomenological parameter based on interfacial state screening (not experimentally calibrated)

kinetic_gate_coupling.classification: Phenomenological carrier-density coupling shifting the thermodynamic free-energy surface

spatial_integration_validation.low_bias_agreement: Accurate to within < 1.5% for V_D <= 1.5 V (+0.16% at post-switching avalanche state V_D = 0.744 V)

switching_threshold_instant.physical_mechanism: Drain pinch-off occurs at x > 0.689 L, but strong electron accumulation persists near source (x <= 0.689 L). Lumped midpoint model represents a conservative lower bound on gate coupling.

thermal_parameters.temperature_definition: Lumped volume-averaged temperature T_avg (not hotspot T_max)

physical_sheet_properties.provenance: Arithmetic scaling from 0.335 nm monolayer reference preserves both G_th,sq and C_th,sq identically.

graphene_off_state.notes: Verified against 1 ps / 5 ps 3D FEA Joule-free transient response on converged fine mesh (P = 1.0 uW).

graphene_on_state.notes: Preserves physical monolayer sheet properties (G_th,sq = 2.01e-7 W/K, C_th,sq = 5.23e-4 J/(m2 K)) with k=201 W/(m K) and rho=737 kg/m3 in 1 nm numerical representation.

thermal_parameters.heat_equation: dT/dt = (P_joule - (T - 300.0) / (R_th_eff + R_tbr_add) - m_VO2 * dH_mit * dfm_dt) / C_th

metrics_at_5_5V.switching_latency_advance_ps: Switches in 152 ps at 2.0 V vs stalls indefinitely at 0.0 V

provenance_and_limitations.spatial_screening: Spatial_Screening_Analytical_Approx.csv is an analytical 1D Thomas-Fermi approximation with assumed lambda_TF = 1.2 nm; NOT an independent COMSOL electrostatic solve.
provenance_and_limitations.switching_latency: In the authoritative model (C_th_on = 7.7989e-17 J/K, tau_th = 41.89 ps), continuous Radau root-finding on percolation threshold fm = 1/3 yields switching latency t_lat = 43.74 ps (VG = 0.0 V) to 36.21 ps (VG = 2.0 V), a deterministic gate speedup Delta t_lat = 7.53 ps. Discrete 25 ps sampling bins both to 50 ps.
provenance_and_limitations.threshold_scaling: Loaded 100 ns ramp switching occurs at V_app = 5.44 V across all gate biases at 0.5 ns sampling (0.08 V step). Gate-dependent threshold shifts are unresolved at this sampling resolution. The legacy 3.51 V -> 3.38 V DC attribution was an unproven scratch-run artifact and is purged from authoritative claims.
provenance_and_limitations.dielectric_reliability: The 2.6 MV/cm oxide field is a nominal analytical estimate (V_ox / t_ox) with idealized electrostatic assumptions. It does not establish local peak field, breakdown endurance, or device reliability.
provenance_and_limitations.thermal_boundary_resistance: Interface thermal boundary resistance was verified in 3D FEA with R_L = 50 kOhm series ballast (Table S4). Top Gr TBR (up to 3e-8 m^2K/W) adds <= 18.66 K; bottom VO2/SiO2 TBR adds <= 31.37 K, bounding peak operating temperatures to <= 425 K and preventing thermal runaway.
provenance_and_limitations.neuromorphic_claims: Single-pulse switching demonstrates volatile threshold relaxation, not multi-pulse leaky integrate-and-fire spike train accumulation. Unverified neuromorphic neuron scaling claims are purged from the authoritative manuscript.
